tenant.title: Tenants
tenant.help: Switch between your apiary collections, or create a new one (e.g. a club).
tenant.invite_sent: Invite link created — share it with them.
tenant.delete_help: Deletes this tenant with all its apiaries, hives and records — for every member. This cannot be undone.
tenant.delete_confirm: Delete tenant “{name}” and all its data permanently? This affects every member and cannot be undone.

data.title: Data & backup
data.export_help: Download all your data — keep a backup, move to another instance, or open it in a spreadsheet.
data.import_help: Restore an Openbeehive backup, or migrate from another beekeeping app (CSV) or a BeeXML file.

dashboard.subtitle: Your bee year at a glance.
dashboard.all_current: All up to date — well done!

stats.title: Development

pk.title: Passkeys
pk.help: Sign in without a password using Face ID, fingerprint or a security key. A passkey is bound to this account and stored on your device.
pk.delete_confirm: Remove this passkey? You can no longer sign in with it.
pk.not_supported: This browser does not support passkeys.

apikeys.title: API keys
apikeys.help: Keys let scripts and devices, such as a hive scale, use the API as you in this tenant. Create one per device and remove it when the device is retired.
apikeys.delete_confirm: Remove this key? Scripts using it stop working immediately.
apikeys.new_help: Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
apikeys.tenant_help: As tenant admin you can remove any member's key, for example when someone leaves or a device is lost.
apikeys.delete_theirs_confirm: Remove this member's key? Their scripts using it stop working immediately.
